prompt: Before you set up the project, ask me which database to use: Postgres, SQLite or MySQL. I should pick exactly one and confirm.
I want to schedule a follow-up email. Collect the recipient name, a subject, a message body and whether to send it only on a weekday, then let me submit.
These checks are available before the release: unit tests, lint, security scan, database migration dry run, smoke test. Let me tick the ones to run and start them.
Show me a small status panel for the import: 340 of 500 rows done, 12 rows failed, state is running. Give me a button to stop it.
You are about to delete the branch feature/old-login. Ask me to confirm, with a clear way to cancel.
Explain in a few paragraphs the difference between a mutex and a channel in Go.
Ask me to approve or reject the production deploy. Name the button actions hil.approve and hil.reject so they go through the approval system.
Here are 120 log files, named app-001.log to app-120.log. Show all of them with a checkbox each, so that I can choose which ones to delete, and add a delete button.
